headline: AuthJS invite flow bug fix
description:
Objective

Fix the AuthJS invite acceptance flow regressions tracked in .copilot/tasks/2026-04-23-invite-flow-fix/.

Scope

  • Remove the invalid request-time pattern from /auth/invite/[token] under Next.js 16 cacheComponents
  • Handle existing-session + different-email conflict explicitly
  • Allow fresh invited users to reach the password-set step instead of being redirected to generic login

Acceptance Criteria

  • The invite page no longer triggers the Blocking RouteServer failure
  • Cross-email invite acceptance is handled explicitly and safely
  • Fresh invited users can complete acceptance without being bounced to the wrong auth entry
  • Validation results are recorded in the repo task workspace

Task Workspace

.copilot/tasks/2026-04-23-invite-flow-fix/
